notes: The normal case is not scanned: no normal short-circuit level is entered
basis: loads, converters and gensets are left out: no damping, so a peak's height is conservative, and no detuning by motor or load reactance, so its frequency is approximate
a resonance peak counts when |Z| stands at least 1.5 times above the higher of its neighbouring minima (PEAK_RATIO)
each cable is one lumped pi, valid while it is short against a quarter wavelength at h_max * f0; a cable longer than 0.4 of that is named in a note (PI_FRACTION)
R rises with sqrt(h) (skin effect) on cables, transformers and the grid; X with h

the grid is IEC 60909's equivalent source c Un^2 / S_sc (c = 1.1 in the max case, 1.0 in the min case above 1 kV, as island_sc_seq.c_factor), so h_r = sqrt(S_sc / (c Q_c)); the normal case takes c = 1.0 (assumed)
transformers at their rated ratio (no off-nominal correction where a bus's kV differs from the winding's), without the magnetising branch
a peak at or above h_max is not reported (the scan has no point beyond it)
harmonic_scan.label: screening; filter design and the binding answer are a harmonic study with the grid's own impedance loci

ledger: P–V nose: the PoC load is stepped at the set power factor (lagging), balanced as a connection-capacity trial (committed units pro-rata to headroom, the slack takes the rest); the last converged and first failing steps bracket the nose and bisection narrows it to tol_mw
every P–V and Q–V load flow enforces generator Q limits

a failing point is retried once from a flat start with more iterations before it counts as past the nose; a rescued P–V point whose PoC voltage does not rise at a slightly lower load is on the low-voltage branch and is rejected; the row records retries, rescues and rejections per sweep
margin = nose MW - planned MW, and as a % of the planned MW; a nose not reached by cap_mw is reported at the cap as a lower bound, never extrapolated

Q–V: a fictitious PV source at the PoC, Q never clipped, swept over its voltage set-point with the planned load connected; the Q margin is minus the curve's minimum Q (positive is margin), a bound when the minimum is on the sweep's edge; dQ/dV is a central difference at the operating point

cases: intact plus the worst N-1 branch and unit outages of the contingency set by PoC voltage with the planned load connected, up to max_cases; an outage that islands or does not converge with the planned load is always listed, not_solved
every row is 'screening; binding answer is the RMS study': static load flow only, no dynamics, controls or protection
grid-side equivalent: source behind Z = c_min·Un²/S_k''min (IEC 60909 c_min) with the PCC's rx_min; intact only, as S_k''min is the weakest grid state entered
planned load per period: the larger of the largest converged PCC import and the rated import; power factor from the max-import hour (lagging), else the default
source EMF: 1.0 pu, or the period's lowest converged PCC voltage when lower
notes: S_k''min 2000 MVA, R/X 0.1, c_min 1 at 110 kV: Z = c·Un²/S_k''min = 6.05 Ω
period 2030: planned load 45.17 MW: the largest converged PCC import (hour 0) binds; probe power factor 0.969 lagging, from hour 0; E = 1.0 pu: no converged PCC voltage of the period is lower
